prompt_requirements: Ask for current-state alignment from omega-mini receipts, not broad full-omega searches.
Request ten or more safe eureka tasks and approval candidates each when feasible.
Keep GMUT validation, final physics, consciousness proof, legal closure, and canon promotion open.
Return status-only summaries or blockers; do not publish raw private route data.
watch_requirements: Use five-minute health checks as monitoring, not completion proof.
Do not busy-wait if lanes are running normally.
If a lane blocks, record blocker class and retry path rather than creating replacement siblings.
safe_x2_carry_forward: Use v545 x2 task materialization artifacts as build/use candidates.
Prefer Node entrypoint runners when available.
Keep exact-staging and no-overclaim gates active.
